description: Create a block in the user's personal day-planner (their own time-blocking schedule, not a board task). Title may reference a board task with `@boardSlug/N` (e.g. `@marketing/42`) — the app renders it as a clickable link to that task. Returns the created block.

active_from.description: Local date YYYY-MM-DD the block starts applying from (default: applies from the start)

end_time.description: End time HH:mm local time, or null

recurrence.description: Repeat rule (default DAILY). ONCE requires scheduled_day.

scheduled_day.description: Local date YYYY-MM-DD — required when recurrence=ONCE

scheduled_time.description: Start time HH:mm local time, or null for unscheduled

title.description: Block title. Use `@boardSlug/N` to link a board task inside the title.

name: create_daily_plan_block
title: Create plan block
